topic: Some people believe that it is better for children to grow up in the countryside, while others argue that the city offers more advantages. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

en.rural area: a geographic area that is located outside cities and towns

en.amenities: desirable or useful features or facilities of a building or place

en.social interaction: the way people talk and act with each other

en.e-commerce: commercial transactions conducted electronically on the internet
en.convenience: the state of being able to do something with little difficulty
en.variety: a number or range of things of the same general class that are distinct in character or quality
en.bargain: a thing bought or offered for sale much more cheaply than is usual or expected
en.delivery: the process of transporting goods from a source to a designated destination
en.returns policy: rules about giving back goods that have been bought
en.privacy concerns: worries about personal information being seen or used by others
en.customer reviews: opinions about a product or service written by people who have bought it

en.captivity: the state of being imprisoned or confined
en.conservation: the action of conserving something, in particular, the preservation of wildlife
en.animal welfare: the physical and mental well-being of animals
en.habitat: the natural home or environment of an animal, plant, or other organism
en.endangered species: a species that is in danger of becoming extinct
en.breeding programmes: programmes that help animals to reproduce in captivity
en.educational value: the worth of something in terms of teaching or learning
en.natural environment: the environment that has not been significantly affected by human activity

topic: The internet has revolutionized the way we communicate and access information. What are the main benefits and drawbacks of the internet?

en.communication tool: something used to exchange information or ideas
en.global village: the world considered as being closely connected by modern communications
en.reliable source: a source that can be trusted for accurate information

en.online privacy: the degree to which your personal information is protected on the internet
en.digital divide: the gap between those who have access to computers and the internet and those who do not

en.cultural exchange: the sharing of ideas and traditions between different cultures
en.environmental impact: the effect that something has on the environment
en.local community: the people who live in a particular area
en.infrastructure: the basic physical and organizational structures and facilities (e.g. buildings, roads, power supplies) needed for the operation of a society or enterprise
en.preserve: to maintain something in its original or existing state
en.exploit: to make full use of and derive benefit from (a resource)
en.sustainable tourism: tourism that takes full account of its current and future economic, social and environmental impacts

en.sedentary lifestyle: a lifestyle characterized by a lot of sitting and little or no exercise
en.processed foods: foods that have been altered from their natural state for safety or convenience

en.metabolism: the chemical processes that occur within a living organism in order to maintain life
en.public health campaign: an organized effort to improve the health of a population
en.nutritional value: the substances in food that are good for your health
en.physical activity: any bodily movement produced by skeletal muscles that requires energy expenditure
en.awareness: knowledge or perception of a situation or fact
en.regulate: to control or maintain the rate or speed of (a machine or process) so that it operates properly
en.contribute to: to help to cause or bring about

en.cost-effective: effective or productive in relation to its cost
en.pass down: to give something to a younger person
en.cultural heritage: the traditions, customs, and artifacts of a cultural group

topic: Many people choose to study abroad. What are the benefits and challenges of studying in a foreign country?

en.broaden horizons: to increase one's range of knowledge, experience, or understanding
en.cultural shock: the feeling of disorientation experienced by someone when suddenly subjected to an unfamiliar culture, way of life, or set of attitudes
en.adapt to: to become adjusted to new conditions
en.gain independence: to become self-reliant and not dependent on others
en.improve language skills: to become better at speaking or understanding a language
en.networking opportunities: chances to meet and interact with people who can be helpful to one's career or social life
en.financial burden: a cost that is difficult to bear
en.homesickness: a feeling of longing for one's home during a period of absence from it
en.global perspective: a way of looking at the world that involves a consideration of various viewpoints and cultures

topic: Climate change is one of the most serious threats facing the world today. What are the causes of climate change, and what measures can be taken to address it?

en.greenhouse gases: gases that trap heat in the atmosphere
en.fossil fuels: natural fuels formed in the geological past from the remains of living organisms
en.carbon footprint: the total amount of greenhouse gases caused by an individual, event, organisation, or product
en.renewable energy: energy from a source that is not depleted when used, such as wind or solar power
en.deforestation: the action of clearing a wide area of trees
en.sustainable practices: ways of doing things that do not harm the environment in the long term
en.global warming: a gradual increase in the overall temperature of the earth's atmosphere
en.sea level rise: an increase in the level of the world's oceans due to the effects of global warming
en.mitigation: the action of reducing the severity, seriousness, or painfulness of something

en.consumerism: the protection or promotion of the interests of consumers
en.manipulate: to control or influence (a person or situation) cleverly, unfairly, or unscrupulously

en.peer pressure: influence from members of one's peer group
